notes: The published title puns 'combat' crudely ('Cumbat'), so this page is titled Alex George DS; the post's title is kept below as published.
Posted 9 December 2001, before Theed Palace (12 December 2001), so the format is Premiere - Reflections III.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting 9': Let Them Make The First Move, Deep Hatred, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core, Prepared Defenses, Crush The Rebellion, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, Wipe Them Out, All Of Them, Fear Is My Ally; these count toward the 60.
The author says he went 11-2 with the deck together with a friend, losing at FCON to Bastian Winkelhaus (QMC) and Chris Praskac (TRM).
The strategy's update says he now plays Force Lightning in place of one Stunning Leader; the list is kept as published.
Posted 'Boba Fett, STUD' dested Boba Fett, Bounty Hunter (the comma-titled Reflections III Boba; the strategy's 'power 7 and 3 destiny' with Zuckuss fits his added battle destiny with an alien).
Posted 'Mauls II Saber' dested Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber (read 'II' as double-bladed).

Posted 'Dre and Panda' dested Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; '4Lom with Conk Gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'EPP Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Zuckuss in Ship' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter.

Posted 'Visage' dested Visage Of The Emperor (listed under Effects); 'S+D' dested Search And Destroy; 'Masterful Move Combo' dested Masterful Move & Endor Occupation; 'Accelerate Plans' dested We Must Accelerate Our Plans.

Posted '@#$%rol' is the site's word filter on 'Control' (the author says so in the strategy) and dested Control; 'Blockade @#$%ship Bridge' dested Blockade Flagship: Bridge; 'Sebulbas Beamer' (strategy: 'Sebulbas Hot Rod') dested Sebulba's Podracer.

The Defensive Shields are the Reflections III Dark shields; TINT, YCHF, Allegations and CHYBC dested There Is No Try, You Cannot Hide Forever, Allegations Of Corruption and Come Here You Big Coward (shield pages).
player_note: The post says he lost with it at FreedomCon to Bastian Winkelhaus and Chris Praskac.
